title: Exclusive: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher's fusion power startup. Here's what they're building. | TechCrunch
summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a stealthy fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher who is taking a different approach to developing a fusion power plant. Like Pacific Fusion, Europa Fusion will pursue a pulsed-power approach to fusion.
